text:
marta_ops: AtlasCompute flagged — 12 chassis units shipped to FRA but customs held the pallet for missing CE declaration. 3 units tested DOA on arrival. need RMA labels and quick decision on temporary loaners from EU pool.

kai_sourcing: thanks. PO# 54321. vendor says expedited re-ship air will be +€6k. any appetite?

sam_atlas: hey — confirmed AWB on hold: `AWB: EC-987654321`. customs asked for chassis certificate, which vendor is pulling. we can do partial air for the 3 DOAs and sea for the rest to save cost.

zane_logistics: partial air works if we can get carrier slots. ETA for air reorder is 48–72h once docs clear. crossdock in FRA preferable to avoid re-clearance.

claire_finance: +€6k expedite sounds steep. can vendor absorb some cost? We were promised 5% expedited credit on DOA replacements per SLA.

sam_atlas: noted. I'll ask Atlas for credit. they offered a 50% waiver last sprint but need sign-off.

ops-bot: RMA created: `RMA-9857` (3 units). docs attached: https://vendor.atlas/claims/RMA-9857

marta_ops: can we approve loaners from EU pool overnight so prod teams don't degrade? will reconcile serials after depot swap.

zane_logistics: we have 6 available in FRA temp-pool but they're reserved for a different commit. proposal: we can release 3 if we take 2 from Amsterdam spare buffer (adds 24h transit).

kai_sourcing: tradeoff: 24h internal transit vs €6k air. I'd prefer internal shift + vendor credit.

claire_finance: agree. approve internal pool+vendor credit. backfill cost center: infra-ops EMEA.

sam_atlas: Atlas agrees to 50% expedite credit on the 3 DOA air shipments if we accept temp-pool loaners. they'll push chassis cert tonight.

marta_ops: ok proceeding: 1) Issue temp loaner release for 3 units (FRA -> customer rack) 2) Accept vendor 50% expedite credit 3) Wait for chassis cert then vendor re-ship remaining 9 via sea (unless customs ask otherwise)

zane_logistics: creating transfer ticket now: `TICKET-FF-3021`. ETA for loaner arrival to site: ~6h after pickup.

ops-bot: Transfer created: `TICKET-FF-3021` (assigned to zane_logistics).

kai_sourcing: sam, please confirm vendor invoice adjustment and get a written credit note. Claire, loop finance on the note for PO adjustment.

sam_atlas: pulling credit note now, will post PDF here when I have it.

marta_ops: also add step to reconcile serials: depot tech to run `check_serials.sh` once loaners arrive and again when replacements arrive. record results in `#asset-audit`.

claire_finance: logged cost estimate: air expedite gross €6k -> vendor credit 50% => net €3k. backfill ledger: infra-ops/expedite. pls attach actual invoice.

sam_atlas: uploaded: https://vendor.atlas/claims/RMA-9857/credit_note.pdf — pending e-sign.

marta_ops: thanks. closing decision thread. if customs rejects chassis cert, we escalate to crossdock + bonded warehouse. will update. :white_check_mark:

zane_logistics: noted. adding customs contact: +49 30 1234 5678 for FRA broker.

ops-bot: thread archived after last update.
